Core Technology Systems

Intelligence
born from silence.

📡
Module 01 · Apex Telemetry
Solar GPS Collar System

Sub-20g solar-harvesting collars with dual-frequency GNSS. Sends location pings every 4 seconds. Waterproof to 30m. Operates across -40°C to 65°C biome ranges.

4s
Ping Interval
99.1%
Accuracy
18mo
Lifespan
🌿
Module 02 · Biome Sync
Serengeti Habitat Mesh

900-node IoT environmental mesh measuring soil moisture, canopy density, prey density indices, and fire-risk thermoclines. Feeds predictive migration AI.

900
Mesh Nodes
2hz
Refresh Rate
14TB
Daily Data
🧬
Module 03 · Genomic
Non-Invasive eDNA Sampling

Environmental DNA collection from water sources, scat, and hair snares. Full genetic profiles without tranquilization—preserving behavioral integrity across the study period.
